title: Binary Root Path Sum
statement:
Add the binary numbers represented by every root-to-leaf path.

Contract
- `root` may be null and every node value is `0` or `1`.
- Interpret each root-to-leaf path as a binary number with the root as the most significant bit.
- Return the sum of all path numbers; a null tree contributes 0.

Examples
- `[1, 0, 1, 0, 1]` has paths `100`, `101`, and `11`, summing to `12`.
- `[1]` returns `1`.
hints: Carry the prefix value as you descend.
Appending a binary digit is a left shift plus that digit.
Only leaves add their current value to the answer. Intended complexity: O(n) time.
inputSyntax: Input: a level-order binary-digit tree, for example: [1, 0, 1, 0, 1]
